title: The pool's eval rows with a path-only or front-matter check get a fact check from one paid Sonnet call
goal: The eval rows of kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv whose check is path-only or whose regex Sonnet wrote from a front-matter line (8 rows by ST-yob4py65's count: 5 path-only rows whose fact was front matter, 3 front-matter regexes) get their checks regenerated from their body-line fact by one paid Sonnet call through bench_pool's own ask (a pool build option that redoes named rows, not a hand edit), so fewer eval rows fall back to a path-only check; the call's spend is reported; the rebuilt csv passes benchmarks.py pool check, and a second offline build reproduces it with no call

run: import csv,json,re,sys; rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['kind'] in ('fact','csv_fact','multi','synthesis')]; po=[r['id'] for r in rows if all('|' not in c and re.search(chr(92)+'.(md|csv)$',c) for c in json.loads(r['checks']))]; old={'BP-90da6231':'required status checks','BP-7b6373d5':'stdio|stdin','BP-df64045a':'APP|MAM'}; kept=[r['id'] for r in rows if r['id'] in old and json.loads(r['checks'])[0].startswith(old[r['id']])]; print(len(rows),'eval rows;',len(po),'path-only (was 10);','old regex kept:',kept); sys.exit(0 if len(rows)==40 and len(po)<10 and len(kept)<3 else 1)

gates.question: What does the pool build option that redoes rows through the paid ask look like, and how are the rows named?
options: --redo ID, repeatable: a pool row id (BP-xxxxxxxx) or an eval case id, with --dry-run listing the rows and the estimate
--redo-pathonly: redoes every eval row whose checks are all article paths
a fixed list of ids in code
gates.recommendation: --redo ID, repeatable: a pool row id (BP-xxxxxxxx) or an eval case id, with --dry-run listing the rows and the estimate
gates.answer: --redo ID, repeatable: a pool row id (BP-xxxxxxxx) or an eval case id, with --dry-run listing the rows and the estimate

gates.question: When a redone row's regenerated regex is unusable, still an article path, or does not match its own fact line, which check does the row hold?
options: the committed check stays, and the build prints the row
gates.recommendation: the committed check stays, and the build prints the row
gates.answer: the committed check stays, and the build prints the row

gates.question: Which stop limits does the dry-run listing apply before the paid call?
options: the build refuses to call when more than 12 rows would be asked or the estimate is over 0.50 USD
no limit in the tool, only the worker's own judgment
gates.recommendation: the build refuses to call when more than 12 rows would be asked or the estimate is over 0.50 USD
gates.answer: the build refuses to call when more than 12 rows would be asked or the estimate is over 0.50 USD

notes: Operator, 2026-10-08: approved one small paid Sonnet call for these rows in this sprint, after ST-yob4py65 kept the committed checks offline (its gate g2). Premise: ST-yob4py65's report counted 10 of 40 eval rows path-only on the committed csv, before and after its fix.
